title: Load balancers
unknownNote_one: {{count}} has no backend data collected (not the same as having none)
unknownNote_other: {{count}} have no backend data collected (not the same as having none)

empty.title: No load balancers
empty.filtered: No load balancers match the current filters. Try widening them.
empty.noSource: No load balancers collected. Check the cloud account is connected under Admin / Cloud accounts.

why.empty: Target is empty and there are confirmed zero backends — this LB cannot serve traffic. A real problem.
why.unknown: Backends were never collected, or an upstream hop failed during resolution. We do not know whether it has backends — do not read this as "none".
why.viaTarget: It has a target, but not a targetPool/backendService (FortiGate forwarding rule, Gateway API target proxy). Traffic is carried by that target; structurally there should be no GCP backend service — not a fault.
why.k8s: The VIP matched a K8s Service. A GKE Service of type=LoadBalancer is backed by Pods (NEG), not instance groups, so instances cannot be traced — but it is serving.
why.lost: Backends were resolved at collection time but cannot be read back — the data was lost, so this row backend verdict is untrustworthy. Re-syncing will not change it; investigate the collection write path.
why.stale: Already deleted in the cloud; only the ledger entry remains.

allPortsHint: 1-65535 means every port on this VIP is forwarded. Worth confirming separately: usually only the few ports actually in use need to be open.
